senses.gloss: to force to apostasy. Y. Shebi. IV, 35ᵃ bot. לא מתכוון מְשַמַּדְתְּכוֹן he has no intention to make you abandon your religion (to persecute you for your religion’s sake), but only to collect taxes &c.; Y. Snh. III, 21ᵇ top משמדתהון (corr. acc.).
units: <cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>לא אתכוון מְשַׁמַּדְתְּהוֹן וכ׳</he> he had no intention to force them to violate their religious laws, but merely wanted to eat fresh bread; Y. Shebi. l. c. <he>מְשַׁמַּדְתּוֹן</he>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 12:43">Targ. O. Ex. XII, 43</cite> (h. text <he>בן נכר</he>).—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 72a:11">Kidd. 72ᵃ</cite> <he>שמתינהו</he> … <he>ואִישְׁתַּמּוּד</he> R. A. excommunicated them, and they renounced Judaism.
